messages.author: dbfd5edddcc94444
messages.subject: INLA crash
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks for your contribution in bayesian inferencing.

I'm trying to run this model (below) and i am getting this error message (*** ERROR ***         INLA.Data1: Binomial data[1692] (nb,y) = (366265,380435) is void). What could be the problem in my model? Looking forward to your response.

v_cov1b <- Vacc_any_train ~ 1 + as.numeric(Week) + as.factor(MnTT2)  + as.numeric(Rural) + as.numeric(Over58) +
  f(Month, model = "ar1", hyper = list(theta = list(prior='pc.prec', param=c(1,0.1)))) +
  f(CID, model ="iid")


mod.1b <- inla(v_cov1b,
               family = "binomial",
               data = Vaccination_cov,
               Ntrials = Pop2,
               control.inla=list(strategy="laplace", tolerance = 1e-20, h=1e-05),
               control.compute=list(config=TRUE, dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, mlik = TRUE, cpo=TRUE),
               control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link=1),
               quantiles =  c(0.025, 0.05,0.5,0.95, 0.975),
               control.fixed= list(expand.factor.strategy = "inla",
                                   #mean.intercept = 1,
                                   prec.intercept = 0.1),
               verbose=TRUE)

summary(mod.1b)
